name: Across From You
source:
Aspen and Evelina are long-time rivals, respectively scoring top #1 and #2 in their class in plant magic. Having lived across from each other for ten years, they both adorn beautiful, elaborate gardens, always trying to one-up each other in the process.

But what happens when an unexpected discovery requires them to work together? Will this newfound cooperation lead to some discoveries about their relationship? Or will their animosity result in dire consequences?

[From [url=https://amanitagames.itch.io/across-from-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿斯彭和埃维琳娜是长期竞争对手，在植物魔法方面分别获得班级第一和第二名。彼此生活了十年，他们都装饰着美丽而精致的花园，在这个过程中总是试图比肩。

但当一个意外的发现需要他们共同努力时，会发生什么呢？这次新的合作是否会给他们的关系带来一些新的发现呢？或者他们的敌意会导致可怕的后果吗？

[来自[url=https://amanitagames.itch.io/across-from-you]itch.io[/url]]
